data.name: Raphaela
data.long_meaning: The Hebrew name Raphaela is derived from the Hebrew word 'Rapha' which means 'healing, to heal'. In the Bible, Raphael is an angel named in the book of Tobit. Raphaela's name symbolizes God's healing power and the idea that God is always present to heal and restore.

in_latin.name: Raphaela
